name: dev-workflows
description: Day-to-day development discipline: brainstorming before building, writing and executing plans, test-driven development, subagent-driven execution, git worktree isolation, running services in their real container, and a pre-push build/lint/test quality gate. Includes /ship, which drives a feature or bug from scoping questions through to a reviewed, QA'd PR, and prune-comments, which strips comments the code can carry itself.
